passages.heading: RUN-OFF ELECTION: November 3rd, 2026
passages.text: Patricia Rumph for Orange County Commissioner District 7 A Stronger Community Starts with its People.

passages.heading: Meet Patricia
passages.text: For more than 30 years, Rumph served the State of Florida in the Florida Department of Corrections, retiring in 2017 after a career that included roles as a Correctional Probation Senior Officer, Human Resources Specialist, and Fiscal Assistant. Her work focused on public safety, rehabilitation, workforce development, budgeting, and supporting individuals and families during some of their most difficult moments. Patricia Rumph also served as President of the Pine Hills Community Council, while also serving on multiple county boards.

passages.heading: Meet Patricia
passages.text: Patricia Rumph’s campaign will focus on public safety, investing in strong infrastructure, affordability and environmental stewardship.

passages.heading: Priorities for District 7
passages.text: Focused on building a safer, more connected, and sustainable Orange County.

passages.heading: Public Safety
passages.text: I believe every family deserves to feel safe in their homes and neighborhoods. Whether it's partnering with local law enforcement to reduce crime, supporting violence prevention programs, or improving emergency services, I'll work tirelessly to ensure our neighborhoods are safe places.

passages.heading: Strong Infrastructure
passages.text: I am committed to building a better Orange County where our roads, public transportation, and community facilities meet the needs of our growing population. This means improving road safety, modernizing public transit, and ensuring our infrastructure keeps pace with our residents' needs.

passages.heading: Affordable Housing
passages.text: Everyone should have access to an affordable place to call home. I'll work to increase accessible housing options and ensure new developments are responsibly planned. A stronger community is one where families can afford to live.

passages.heading: Environmental Stewardship
passages.text: Protecting our environment is about ensuring a healthy Orange County for generations to come. I will champion responsible growth policies, conservation of our natural resources, and initiatives that reduce pollution and safeguard our water sources.

passages.heading: Introduction
passages.text: Patricia Rumph is a lifelong Orange County resident with over 30 years of service, dedicated to strengthening communities and building a safer future for District 7.

passages.heading: Youth
passages.text: Patricia Rumph believes mentorship shapes strong futures, guiding youth with structure, support, and opportunity to help them grow, succeed, and thrive in Orange County

passages.heading: Housing
passages.text: Patricia Rumph supports affordable housing and responsible development, ensuring working families, seniors, and essential workers can live, work, and thrive in the communities they serve.

passages.heading: Crime
passages.text: Patricia Rumph focuses on violence prevention, youth intervention, and stronger community trust, working to reduce crime, improve emergency response, and build safer neighborhoods.

passages.heading: Small Business
passages.text: Patricia Rumph supports small businesses by expanding opportunity, reducing barriers, and streamlining processes to help entrepreneurs grow and strengthen the local economy.

passages.heading: Environmental
passages.text: Patricia Rumph is committed to protecting waterways, preserving green space, and ensuring clean, safe, and sustainable environments for future generations across Orange County.

passages.heading: Safety Workforce
passages.text: Patricia Rumph supports public safety professionals and essential workers by prioritizing training, mental health, and fair pay for those who serve and protect our community every day.

passages.heading: Transparency
passages.text: Patricia Rumph is committed to transparency, accountability, and responsible planning, ensuring community voices are heard and delivering results that serve the people of District 7.

passages.heading: Infrastructure
passages.text: Patricia Rumph supports investing in infrastructure that keeps pace with growth, focusing on transportation, drainage, and smart planning to protect families for a safer, more resilient OCFL.

passages.heading: Reentry & Training
passages.text: Patricia Rumph supports workforce training and second-chance opportunities, helping individuals become productive citizens, reduce recidivism, and build safer communities across OCFL.

passages.heading: My name is Patricia Rumph
passages.text: a proud lifelong resident of Orange County. I was raised by a remarkable single mother who taught me the value of hard work, resilience, and the responsibility to serve others. She showed me—through her life, not just her words—that no matter where you come from, you can make the place you live a better, safer, and stronger community.

passages.heading: My name is Patricia Rumph
passages.text: I have lived that principle every day. I have built a life of service, leadership, and commitment to the people of Orange County.

passages.heading: My name is Patricia Rumph
passages.text: In 2020, I was honored to be appointed the Inaugural Community Ambassador, a role created to strengthen trust between law enforcement and residents and to lead efforts aimed at reducing gun violence and violent crime in our neighborhoods.

passages.heading: My name is Patricia Rumph
passages.text: Before that appointment, I volunteered for three years as President of the Pine Hills Community Council, while also serving on multiple county boards and committees where I proudly represent our community. I am here because I believe every neighborhood deserves opportunity, every family deserves support, and every resident deserves to be seen, heard, and respected.

passages.heading: My name is Patricia Rumph
passages.text: For more than 30 years, I served the State of Florida in the Department of Corrections, helping to guide individuals, protect communities, and support families during some of their most challenging moments.

passages.heading: My name is Patricia Rumph
passages.text: Service is not something I talk about—it’s something I live.
